answer.value: Hugging Face Transformers format weights compatible with vLLM, SGLang, TokenSpeed; deployable via SGLang, vLLM and TokenSpeed; usable through the Chat Completions API (OpenAI Python SDK) including Qwen Cloud; thinking mode required, with reasoning_effort (xhigh default, medium, low) and preserve_thinking options.
quotes: This repository contains model weights and configuration files for the post-trained model in the Hugging Face Transformers format.
These artifacts are compatible with vLLM, SGLang, TokenSpeed, etc.

The Chat Completions API can be used with most inference frameworks, as well as [Qwen Cloud](https://www.qwencloud.com).
Qwen3.8 comes with official support for `reasoning_effort`, which can be used to adjust reasoning depth and control cost:
